summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 CAD Editor additions (STEP dropdown, FIT GRID, zoom-out/in buttons). All 11 test steps passed on Demo · Villa Atlas.

test_results.STEP_dropdown_data-testid_cad-grid-step: PASS — <select> present, options [0.5,1,2,5,10] rendered as [6",1',2',5',10'], default=2
test_results.grid_density_scales_with_step: PASS — SVG <line> counts: step=0.5 → 460 lines, step=2 → 160 lines, step=10 → 80 lines (monotonic)
test_results.localStorage_key_atlas-cad-grid-step: PASS — writes on change; value 5 persists across full page reload
test_results.cad-zoom-out_1.25x: PASS — ratio 1.2500 exactly, viewBox center preserved (drift < 0.5)
test_results.zoom-out_cap_400: PASS — repeated clicks plateau at w=400.0
test_results.zoom-in_floor_2: PASS — repeated clicks plateau at w=2.0
test_results.gridStep_change_does_not_mark_dirty: PASS — SAVE stayed disabled before AND after changing STEP alone (regression protected)
test_results.cad-snap-to-grid_FIT_GRID_dirties_sheet: PASS — SAVE went from disabled→enabled after click
test_results.Ctrl+Z_reverts_FIT_GRID_in_one_snapshot: PASS — geometry hash after single Ctrl+Z matched pre-FIT hash exactly
test_results.L_tool_draw_wall_still_works: PASS — activation + click flow reachable (endpoints snap via snappedPoint using current gridStep)

critical_code_review_comments: CadEditorTab.jsx is 1,769 lines — well over the 700-line soft cap. Consider extracting toolbar (~200 lines around 900-1100), gridLines useMemo, and drawing tool handlers into sub-modules.
FIT GRID marks the sheet dirty even when no coordinates actually changed (e.g. walls already on the step grid). Minor UX nit — could compare pre/post state before calling markDirty().
gridStep useState initializer touches localStorage on every render of the parent tree; safe here but keep in mind if the component gets remounted heavily.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing Demo · Villa Atlas project
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three requested CAD features (grid STEP dropdown, FIT GRID snap-all, zoom-out/in) are wired correctly with data-testids cad-grid-step / cad-snap-to-grid / cad-zoom-out / cad-zoom-in / cad-reset-view. GridStep persists via localStorage key 'atlas-cad-grid-step'. Zoom clamps to [2, 400] and preserves center. FIT GRID captured in undo history. gridStep change alone does NOT mark the sheet dirty (regression preserved).
